source.name: 足球报 (Soccer News) via Tencent News: 中超新气象：11队更换胸前广告，首轮上座再超去年 (New CSL picture: 11 clubs changed front-of-shirt ads)
source.note: Translation: 'Henan changed its front-of-shirt advertising from Dukang and Huahuaniu to Yangshao Caitaofang.' Reporter: Lu Mi (记者鲁蜜). The Yangshao Liquor naming deal itself was signed at the club's 4 March 2026 season-launch ceremony (Dahe Finance Cube), after which the team competes as 'Henan FC Caitaofang'.
source.quote: 河南队将胸前广告从杜康、花花牛更换为仰韶彩陶坊

source.name: Footy Headlines: 2026 Chinese Super League Kits - All Releases So Far
source.note: Kit supplier for all 16 CSL clubs in 2026; Henan FC has its own section in the article (bespoke home design). Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers.
source.quote: Nike has officially unveiled the 2026 Home Kits for all 16 teams competing in the Chinese Super League (CSL).

summary: 2026 CSL home kit by Nike (league-wide release 28 January 2026). Front sponsor Yangshao Caitaofang (仰韶彩陶坊), the baijiu brand of Henan Yangshao Liquor; the naming-rights deal was signed at the 4 March 2026 season-launch ceremony and the club competes as 'Henan FC Caitaofang' this season. Back, sleeve and shorts placements could not be verified from sources we could open (Henan Daily's kit-launch page returns 403 to scripts; footballkitarchive.com 403s; the club's January sponsorship notice offered chest, back and kit-advertising slots but names no taker), so the list is not marked complete. 2025's front carried Dukang and Huahuaniu per the Soccer News report.
